evidenceType: Blender source render, not actual app
findings: Actual treads, curved rails and trunk supports read as a staircase in the close view, improving on the smooth v4 band.
The whole view does not yet establish a welcoming upper gallery or its endpoint; the broad rise is partly concealed by the fan.

The inherited close camera was obstructed by foreground leaves and a black near cut. A new three-quarter camera removes the black cut without changing the geometry or visibility, while existing crowns still obscure lower stairs and fan leaves conceal part of the upper gallery.
The wider island still has sparse forest masses, a broad bare hill and angular thin paths relative to native05. This local stair improvement does not pass whole-island art.

decision: Retain actual sixteen-step construction as the working basis. Saved entry and body-band contacts have been classified; the next implementation must establish actual per-foot tread contact and continuous riser clearance with all nine real rigs. No more camera-only iterations now; no hidden ramp and no source-only runtime acceptance.
